commits.message:
refactor: clarify variable names in diagnostic processing loop

Rename ambiguous single-letter and overloaded names in main's
compiler-message loop to reflect their domain meaning:
- msg -> cargo_record (the whole cargo JSON record)
- message -> diagnostic (the inner rustc diagnostic)
- msg_text -> diagnostic_message
- s / span_obj -> span / primary_span
- line_str -> line
